```{r libraries, echo=TRUE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)
library(stringr)

source(here::here("functions/load_functions.R"))

load(here::here("results/results_sensitivity_betaB_rho_TS_registry250_10.rData"))
```


```{r split-null-alt, echo=FALSE}
res_alt_list <- purrr::map(
  results_list_sensitivity,
  ~ dplyr::filter(.x, effect_setting == "alternative")
)

res_null_list <- purrr::map(
  results_list_sensitivity,
  ~ dplyr::filter(.x, effect_setting == "null")
)

scenario_lookup <- sensitivity_pools |>
  dplyr::select(scenario_id, beta_B, rho_B_TS)
```

```{r main-results-sens, echo=FALSE}
main_results_sens <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  res_alt_list,
  ~ summarise_main_results(.x, group_vars = c("method")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(scenario_id = .y, .before = 1)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(scenario_lookup, by = "scenario_id")
```

```{r bias-decomposition-sens, echo=FALSE}

bias_decomposition_sens <- main_results_sens |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    scenario_id, beta_B, rho_B_TS, method, n_valid,

    # ── DeltaS — matched ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mean_deltaS_matched_obs, true_deltaS,
    total_bias_deltaS_matched,
    trial_est_error_S,
    matched_control_est_error_S,
    matching_error_S,
    sampling_error_deltaS,
    reconstructed_bias_deltaS_matched,
    check_deltaS_matched =
      total_bias_deltaS_matched - reconstructed_bias_deltaS_matched,

    # ── DeltaS — naive (full registry) ──────────────────────────────────────
    mean_deltaS_naive_obs,
    total_bias_deltaS_naive,
    registry_est_error_S,
    registry_selection_error_S,
    reconstructed_bias_deltaS_naive,
    check_deltaS_naive =
      total_bias_deltaS_naive - reconstructed_bias_deltaS_naive,

    # ── DeltaRMST — matched ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mean_deltaRMST_matched_obs, true_deltaRMST,
    total_bias_deltaRMST_matched,
    trial_est_error_RMST,
    matched_control_est_error_RMST,
    matching_error_RMST,
    sampling_error_deltaRMST,
    reconstructed_bias_deltaRMST_matched,
    check_deltaRMST_matched =
      total_bias_deltaRMST_matched - reconstructed_bias_deltaRMST_matched,

    # ── DeltaRMST — naive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mean_deltaRMST_naive_obs,
    total_bias_deltaRMST_naive,
    registry_est_error_RMST,
    registry_selection_error_RMST,
    reconstructed_bias_deltaRMST_naive,
    check_deltaRMST_naive =
      total_bias_deltaRMST_naive - reconstructed_bias_deltaRMST_naive
  )

# Sanity check: the decomposition residuals must be negligible.
# (If they are not, it is a bug in the decomposition, not an artefact of the grid.)
max_check <- bias_decomposition_sens |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::starts_with("check_"),
                                 ~ max(abs(.x), na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## Balance — preview

Balance diagnostics on the observed covariates across cells (`beta_B`,
`rho_B_TS`) at fixed `registry_n` = 250. Since B does not enter the score,
balance on the observed covariates is expected to be essentially stable across
the grid: any marked variation deserves inspection.

```{r balance-table, echo=FALSE}
balance_sens |>
  dplyr::select(beta_B, rho_B_TS, method, dplyr::everything(),
                -scenario_id, -registry_n) |>
  dplyr::arrange(method, beta_B, rho_B_TS) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::autofit()
```

## Bias decomposition — preview (DeltaS)

Sign convention "B" (as in Table 4 of the paper): contributions are displayed
already oriented so that they add up directly to the total bias. Telescoping
identity:

- matched: `Total = Trial est.err (-) Control est.err (-) Matching err (+) Sampling err`
- naive:  `Total = Trial est.err (-) Registry est.err (-) Selection err (+) Sampling err`

`Check` = `Total - reconstructed`; must be ~0.

```{r bias-decomposition-table-matched}
bias_decomposition_sens |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    `Trial est. error`    = trial_est_error_S,
    `-Control est. error` = -matched_control_est_error_S,
    `-Matching error`     = -matching_error_S,
    `Sampling error`      = sampling_error_deltaS,
    `Total bias`          = total_bias_deltaS_matched,
    `Check`               = check_deltaS_matched
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(method, beta_B, rho_B_TS) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::colformat_double(digits = 3) |>
  flextable::set_caption("Bias decomposition on \u0394S — matched benchmark.") |>
  flextable::autofit()
```

```{r bias-decomposition-table-naive}
bias_decomposition_sens |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    `Trial est. error`     = trial_est_error_S,
    `-Registry est. error` = -registry_est_error_S,
    `-Selection error`     = -registry_selection_error_S,
    `Sampling error`       = sampling_error_deltaS,

```

# Operating characteristics: Type I error and power

`summarise_decision_performance` (already used for S0-S4) computes the Type I
error from the `null` branch and the power from the `alternative` branch,
separately by method.

```{r decision-sens, echo=FALSE}
decision_sens <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  res_null_list,
  res_alt_list,
  ~ summarise_decision_performance(
      res_null         = .x,
      res_alt          = .y,
      alpha            = 0.10,
      scenario_label   = NULL,
      registry_n_label = "250"
    ),
  .id = "scenario_id"
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(scenario_lookup, by = "scenario_id")
```

```{r decision-sens-long, echo=FALSE}
decision_sens_long <- decision_sens |>
  dplyr::select(
    registry_n,
    scenario_id,
    beta_B,
    rho_B_TS,
    method,
    dplyr::starts_with("typeI_"),
    dplyr::starts_with("power_")
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("typeI_") | dplyr::starts_with("power_"),
    names_to = "decision_rule",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    stat = ifelse(stringr::str_ends(decision_rule, "_mcse"), "mcse", "reject_prob"),
    decision_rule = stringr::str_remove(decision_rule, "_mcse$")
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_starts(decision_rule, "typeI_") ~ "Type I error",
      stringr::str_starts(decision_rule, "power_") ~ "Power",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    test = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(decision_rule, "one_sample_lr") ~ "One-sample log-rank",
      stringr::str_detect(decision_rule, "two_sample_lr") ~ "Two-sample log-rank",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    benchmark = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(decision_rule, "registry") ~ "Registry benchmark",
      stringr::str_detect(decision_rule, "matched")  ~ "Matched benchmark",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    registry_n, scenario_id, beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    metric, test, benchmark, reject_prob, mcse
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(beta_B, rho_B_TS, metric, test, benchmark, method)
```

## Summary table (one-sample log-rank)

```{r decision-table-one-sample, echo=FALSE}
benchmark_cols <- decision_sens |>
  dplyr::select(
    scenario_id, beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    benchmark_registry       = mean_registry_est,
    benchmark_matched        = mean_matched_est,
    benchmark_counterfactual = mean_trial_z0_est,
    survival_treated         = mean_trial_z1_est,
    deltaS_registry          = mean_deltaS_registry,
    deltaS_matched           = mean_deltaS_matched,
    deltaS_counterfactual    = mean_deltaS_oracle
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

decision_table_one_sample_wide <- decision_sens_long |>
  dplyr::filter(test == "One-sample log-rank") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    colname = dplyr::case_when(
      metric == "Type I error" & benchmark == "Registry benchmark" ~ "typeI_registry",
      metric == "Type I error" & benchmark == "Matched benchmark"  ~ "typeI_matched",
      metric == "Power"        & benchmark == "Registry benchmark" ~ "power_registry",
      metric == "Power"        & benchmark == "Matched benchmark"  ~ "power_matched"
    ),
    value = sprintf("%.3f (%.4f)", reject_prob, mcse)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(colname)) |>
  dplyr::select(scenario_id, beta_B, rho_B_TS, method, colname, value) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = colname, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    benchmark_cols,
    by = c("scenario_id", "beta_B", "rho_B_TS", "method")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    benchmark_counterfactual, benchmark_registry, benchmark_matched, survival_treated,
    deltaS_counterfactual, deltaS_registry, deltaS_matched,
    typeI_registry, typeI_matched, power_registry, power_matched
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(beta_B, rho_B_TS, method)
```

```{r decision-table-flextable, echo=FALSE}
decision_table_one_sample_wide |>

    beta_B = "\u03b2B",

    power_registry = "Power: registry",

  ) |>

```


```{r plot-data, echo=FALSE}
plot_dat_compare <- decision_sens |>
  dplyr::select(
    beta_B, rho_B_TS, method,
    power_one_sample_lr_registry_1s,
    power_one_sample_lr_matched_1s,
    typeI_one_sample_lr_registry_1s,
    typeI_one_sample_lr_matched_1s
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(beta_B, rho_B_TS, method),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_starts(measure, "power") ~ "Power",
      stringr::str_starts(measure, "typeI") ~ "Type I error"
    ),
    benchmark = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(measure, "registry") ~ "Registry",
      stringr::str_detect(measure, "matched")  ~ "Matched"
    )
  )
```



# Profiles at fixed beta_B

```{r line-plot-function, echo=FALSE}
make_line_plot <- function(dat, beta_B_value) {
  ggplot(
    dat |> dplyr::filter(beta_B == beta_B_value),
    aes(
      x = rho_B_TS,
      y = value,
      color = benchmark,
      linetype = metric,
      group = interaction(benchmark, metric)
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      data = data.frame(metric = "Type I error", yint = 0.10),
      aes(yintercept = yint),
      linetype = "dashed",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      data = data.frame(metric = "Power", yint = 0.80),
      aes(yintercept = yint),
      linetype = "dashed",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ method) +
    labs(
      x = expression(rho[B,TS]),
      y = "Probability",
      color = "Benchmark",
      linetype = "Metric",
      title = bquote(paste("Power and Type I error for ", beta[B], " = ", .(beta_B_value))),
      subtitle = "One-sided one-sample log-rank test"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```
